Hi Rishi,

Quick intro — I'm Liam (Head of Platform @ BlueHorizon Commerce). We're evaluating hosted inference providers for a multi-market rollout and we'd like a straight baseline from Redwood on hosted API pricing plus any ability to match or get near parity with competitor quotes (specifically OpenAI, Anthropic, TogetherAI and AWS Bedrock).

Our rough profile for the pilot:~
- Tokens: ~400M tokens/month (prompt + completion)
- Latency target: p95 < 400ms for short-turn chat (<= 512 tokens)
- Embeddings: 1M vectors/month

What we need from you today: a simple ratecard (per-token gen, per-embedding) for hosted API, and a note on how Redwood can approach parity with the four vendors above. If you can indicate what discounts or commit levels would be required to match OpenAI's quoted blended token price (they sent a PDF) that would be helpful.

Attached: OpenAI quote they shared.

Thanks — can we aim for an answer by EOD PST?

—Liam

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the patience while I coordinated internally. Summary below and next steps.

1) Baseline hosted rates (public / no commit)
- Text generation (low-latency hosted): $0.00018 per token (blended prompt+completion estimate)
- Embeddings (1536-dim): $0.00045 per vector
- Notes: standard rate limits apply; multi-region endpoints available (US/EU). SLA: 99.9% uptime for hosted API; latency targets depend on route and pool (we can commit to p95 < 400ms for <=512 tokens with an accelerated pool).

2) Parity guidance vs. competitors (quick)
- OpenAI: their quoted blended $0.00012/token is achievable on Redwood with a 12-month commit. To get to ~$0.00012 blended we can offer a committed plan of $120k/month ($1.44M annual) with a blended effective token price in the $0.000115-$0.00013 range depending on exact prompt/completion split and monthly overage cadence. Embedding parity: we can get to ~$0.00030/vector with a similar commit + a rebate schedule above 1M vectors/month.
- Anthropic / Together / AWS: parity depends on feature parity (model family and latency). For Together/AWS there is typically less promo room; Anthropic quotes tend to be higher for similar configs. We can provide specific run-rate comparisons if you share which model families you're comparing.

3) Packaging and product notes
- Recommendation: 12-month committed hosted plan that maps to your 400M token/month baseline with a 10% headroom buffer and an embedding tranche. This gives predictable unit economics and allows us to allocate an accelerated regional pool to meet p95 latency SLOs.
- We can include Redwood Optimize credits to tune batching/quantization for your workload (this materially reduces billed tokens).

4) Next steps / asks from you
- Confirm whether you want a formal term sheet (I can send a draft PO-ready proposal with DocuSign).
- Confirm exact model families you're benchmarking (OpenAI model id / Anthropic model / Together model / Bedrock config).

Attached: BH-Proposal-v1.pdf (proposal stub). If you want to proceed with a committed plan I'll loop in Legal for a short SOW + standard terms.

Happy to jump on a 30m call tomorrow to walk the numbers.

Best,
